Now find connected components.

Component F: (4,3)? Neighbors: up (3,3)=5, down (5,3)=0, left (4,2)=5, right (4,4)=5. So connects to (5,3). (5,3) neighbors: up (4,3), down (6,3)=5, left (5,2)=5, right (5,4)=5. So component size2: (4,3),(5,3). Color 2.
